description: Count what a live WordPress site holds before anyone promises to move it, write the new site's redirects, and check them after the move. Read-only toward the site: no login, no backup. scripts/wp_inventory.py counts each content type the REST API lists, where the sitemap disagrees, page builders and forms, and whether the count is complete. scripts/make_redirects.py turns its address list and the owner's decisions into public/_redirects lines. scripts/check_move.py asks the new site for each old address and names those missing, sent home or not where the decisions say. Stdlib Python. Trigger phrases: "how big is this WordPress site", "count the pages", "WordPress migration estimate", "what plugins does this site use", "write the redirects", "redirect map for the move", "did every page make the move", "check the redirects after the move", "are any old addresses broken".
